{{Quote|Further&mdash;think about this. With Captain Joshi dead and Provocateur destroyed, whom do you suppose is next in line for command of Implacable?|Warlord Zsinj to Garik Loran, who was impersonating Zurel Darillian|<ref name="WS" />}}
'''Joshi''' served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and commanded the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|escort frigate]] ''[[Provocateur]]'' under [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].

==Biography==
Joshi was ordered by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] to go to [[Talasea]] and join the [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|''Implacable'']], ''[[Constrictor]]'' and [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']] in ambushing the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] force shadowing ''Night Caller''. But Zsinj didn't know that [[Wraith Squadron]] had already taken control of ''Night Caller'' and was planning their own ambush for his forces.<ref name="WS" />

During the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump to the [[Morobe system]], ''Implacable'' discovered the ambush and dropped out of their jump. Without the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], ''Night Caller'' managed to disable both ships single-handedly in a short [[Battle of Talasea|battle]]. Joshi [[Death/Legends|lost]] his life, along with everyone aboard, when a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] salvo snapped ''Provocateur'' in half.<ref name="WS" />

==Skills and abilities==
Joshi was a capable officer that Zsinj had him next in line for the command of the ''Implacable''.<ref name="WS" />
